T0540.title: Software Supply Chain
T0540.definition: The ecosystem of source code, dependencies, build systems, tools, artifacts, and release processes used to deliver software.
T0540.description: The software supply chain spans source code, dependencies, build systems, tools, artifacts, release processes, and deployment. Attackers can inject malicious changes at any stage, so governance must cover developer identities, code review, dependency sources, build isolation, signature verification, and supplier components, not only production runtime.
T0540.usageExample: Assess Software Supply Chain related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
